title: Creamy Pesto Chicken
description: This creamy pesto chicken recipe has a flavorful Italian pesto made with fresh basil, pine nuts, Parmesan, and garlic. The recipe also works well with thinly sliced pork tenderloin. Serve over rice or pasta with extra Parmesan cheese to sprinkle on top.
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips
1 (8 ounce) container reduced fat sour cream

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook chicken for about 5 minutes, until lightly browned. Mix garlic and sherry into the skillet. Cook and stir until all liquid is reduced, chicken is no longer pink, and juices run clear.
Mix pine nuts into the skillet, and cook 2 to 3 minutes over medium heat. Reduce heat to low, and mix in basil, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, and pepper. Continue cooking until heated through.
